placeholder.policy: The browser draws these spans as embedded text (Canvas.emb): Arabic with RTL shaping, and one mojibake line holding a soft hyphen. A terminal cannot reproduce either cell for cell, so every embedded span is replaced: its w cells, starting at (x, y), hold the text of "text" left-aligned and then spaces, every cell with the span's fg and bg. "spans" keeps each original string and its direction for reference.
